verdict.rationale: Basecamp's own feature docs explicitly cover the full story: to-do lists where items can be assigned and given due dates, with co-workers invited into the project. Community comments in the pack are general sentiment and do not address task assignment. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation beyond a marketing-page summary, independent or hands-on corroboration of assignment and due-date behavior.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create tasks and assign them to teammates with due dates

citations.quote: Make a list, or ten lists. Assign items, set due dates, attach files, even create subtasks.
Add the tools you need (to-dos, message boards, chat, a calendar, card tables), then invite co-workers, clients, even AI Agents.
